name: rowcount
product: Row and stitch counter for knitters and crocheters (web and iOS), with chart import from PDF patterns
bestFitCustomers: Hobby knitters who follow PDF patterns with charts
pricing: Free for one project; Plus $4 a month or $36 a year
principles: No selling or sharing user data

predictions.move: Email 40 independent yarn shops offering a free co-branded counter card for their counters
predictions.metric: Shops that agree to stock the card
predictions.stop: Stop if fewer than 3 of 40 shops agree by 2026-09-15

predictions.move: Add a first-run prompt that asks new users to import a PDF chart
predictions.metric: Share of new accounts that import a chart in week 1
predictions.stop: Stop if under 25% of new accounts import a chart in week 1, over 4 weeks after release
